$ envoy 
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: expected one of "run", "collect", "wait", "pending", "version"
Usage: envoy <command> [flags]
Run "envoy --help" for details.

$ envoy nonsense
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: unexpected argument nonsense
Usage: envoy <command> [flags]
Run "envoy --help" for details.

$ envoy run --prompt-file $HOME/brief.md --with codex
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: expected "<job>"
Usage: envoy run --with=VOICE[=FILE] <job> [flags]
Run "envoy run --help" for details.

$ envoy run 'bad name' --prompt-file $HOME/brief.md --with codex
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: job name "bad name": a name is one segment of letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit; use a path (starting with / or ./) for anything else

$ envoy run job --prompt-file $HOME/brief.md
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: missing flags: --with=VOICE[=FILE]
Usage: envoy run --with=VOICE[=FILE] <job> [flags]
Run "envoy run --help" for details.

$ envoy run job --with gemini --prompt-file $HOME/brief.md
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: --with 'gemini' must name provider claude or codex, got 'gemini'

$ envoy run job --with codex
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: --with codex has no prompt: attach one to the voice (--with codex=<file>) or give every voice a default with --prompt-file <file>

$ envoy run job --with codex= --prompt-file $HOME/brief.md
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: --with codex=: give the prompt file after '=' (--with codex=<file>), or drop the '=' to use --prompt-file

$ envoy run job --with codex=$HOME/absent.md
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: prompt file not found: $HOME/absent.md

$ envoy run job --with codex --prompt-file $HOME
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: prompt file is a directory, not a file: $HOME

$ envoy run job --with claude::minimal --prompt-file $HOME/brief.md
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: --with 'claude::minimal': effort 'minimal' is not valid for claude. Valid: low, medium, high, xhigh, max (claude has no 'minimal'; its lowest is 'low')

$ envoy run job --with claude:opus:high:extra --prompt-file $HOME/brief.md
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: --with 'claude:opus:high:extra' has too many fields; the form is provider[:model[:effort]], for example claude:opus:high

$ envoy run job --with codex --with claude --prompt-file $HOME/brief.md --allow-write
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: --allow-write needs exactly one --with: a fan-out's members share one working tree, and turns editing the same files concurrently overwrite each other's work. For parallel write work, give each turn its own tree — a git worktree per turn — and run them as separate jobs with --cwd <tree>.

$ envoy run job --with codex --prompt-file $HOME/brief.md extra
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: unexpected argument extra
Usage: envoy run --with=VOICE[=FILE] <job> [flags]
Run "envoy run --help" for details.

$ envoy run job --with codex --prompt-file $HOME/brief.md --model opus
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: unknown flag --model
Usage: envoy run --with=VOICE[=FILE] <job> [flags]
Run "envoy run --help" for details.

$ envoy run job --with codex --prompt-file $HOME/brief.md --timeout-min -1
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: --timeout-min: expected float value but got "-1" (short flag); perhaps try --timeout-min="-1"?
Usage: envoy run --with=VOICE[=FILE] <job> [flags]
Run "envoy run --help" for details.

$ envoy run job --with codex --prompt-file $HOME/brief.md --timeout-min=-1
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: --timeout-min must be a number >= 0 (0 = no cap)

$ envoy run job --with codex --prompt-file $HOME/brief.md --max-budget-usd 1
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: --max-budget-usd caps one claude voice; codex has no budget flag

$ envoy run job --with claude --with codex --prompt-file $HOME/brief.md --max-budget-usd 1
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: --max-budget-usd caps one claude voice; codex has no budget flag

$ envoy run job --with claude --prompt-file $HOME/brief.md --version
exit 0
--- stdout
envoy 0.15.0
--- stderr

$ envoy run job --with codex --prompt-file $HOME/brief.md --instructions-file $HOME/absent.md
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: instructions file not found: $HOME/absent.md

$ envoy run job --with codex=$HOME/brief.md --with claude:opus
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: --with claude:opus has no prompt: attach one to the voice (--with claude:opus=<file>) or give every voice a default with --prompt-file <file>

$ envoy run job --with codex=$HOME/brief.md --with claude:opus=$HOME/absent.md
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: prompt file not found: $HOME/absent.md

$ envoy run job --with codex --with claude:opus=$HOME/brief.md --prompt-file $HOME/absent.md
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: prompt file not found: $HOME/absent.md

$ envoy collect

Run "envoy collect --help" for details.

$ envoy collect --result-only --status-only job
exit 3
--- stdout
--- stderr
envoy: error: --result-only and --status-only can't be used together
Usage: envoy collect <job> [flags]
Run "envoy collect --help" for details.

--- stderr
